summary.text: Cedrick Frazier is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 43A.
The House member page lists his occupation as attorney, his election year as 2020, and committee assignments including Ways and Means and Judiciary Finance and Civil Law.

paragraphs.text: Frazier's education is listed as a B.A. in psychology from the University of Minnesota, Morris; an M.A. in urban studies and local government management from Minnesota State University, Mankato; and a J.D. from William Mitchell College of Law.
His profile lists his family as married to Stella, with three children.

sources.title: Rep. Cedrick Frazier (43A) - Minnesota House of Representatives
